name: workflows
description: Sets up or reconciles a project's OpenSpec workflow in one command: schemas and subagents for a chosen complexity level, a rewritten openspec/config.yaml that carries forward what you wrote, and guarded plugin installation. Re-runnable, with --check for read-only drift reporting. Also routes a piece of work to the right schema among the twelve it installs, and ships a self-paced learning package covering installation, routing, and every workflow end to end.
